card.name: Start of words like chronic, sympathomimetic, citrate
card.fires_on: The first piece of a longer medical word that is still unfinished, such as chronic, sympath(omimetics), cit(rate) and ec-z(ema). It fires where the rest of the word is yet to come.

modes.label: Chronic
modes.description: The word chronic before a condition such as bronchitis or infection.

card.writes: It pushes toward word endings like -ic, -icus and -ics, which suggests finishing a word that is cut off.
card.plain: It lights up on the opening piece of a long medical word, such as sympath- or cit-, before the word is finished.
